# Coverage configuration (SPEC.md §5 src-layout; test_coverage dim).
#
# `taskq_api.__main__` is the dedicated entry-point module that backs
# `python -m taskq_api key create --scope <scope>` (SPEC.md §3 FR-03).
# Its `if __name__ == "__main__":` guard (lines 104-105) is unreachable
# from in-process callers — Python only evaluates it when the module is
# executed as `__main__`, not when imported. Per the Gate 1
# coverage-fix ESCAPE HATCH, dedicated entry-point modules are excluded
# at the file level via [coverage:run] omit rather than annotated with
# `# pragma: no cover` (which is not a valid target for entry-point
# guards). The executable body of `__main__.py` is still exercised by
# in-process tests in 03-development/tests/test_fr03.py — the omit only
# stops coverage.py from counting the entry-point guard as missing.
[coverage:run]
omit =
    03-development/src/taskq_api/__main__.py

# `03-development/tests/`; the `harness/` subtree holds the framework's
# own self-tests, which depend on framework-private paths
